sections.title: Fats

closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, omega 3, and magnesium, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low starch, and real serving sizes are often small. It is good for bone health, hormone health, and muscles and strength sports because magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, the fat section has enough useful fats for a support role, and the protein section supports repair and maintenance.
